title: Four Irreducible Primitives
description: The four fundamental ingredients of physical reality in SDT: Space (Spation), Matter (Displacement), Movement (Shunt Dynamics), and Now (Time Emergence).

content.markdown:
# Four Irreducible Primitives

SDT is built on four irreducible primitives that cannot be reduced further:

## 1. SPACE (Spation)

The spation lattice is the fundamental structure of space. It consists of Planck-scale particles arranged in a dodecahedral packing structure.

- Bulk modulus: $K_{\text{bulk}} = 4.6 \times 10^{113}$ Pa
- Provides the pressure field from CMB
- Incompressible medium

## 2. MATTER (Displacement)

Matter is definitive hard shapes that displace spations, creating pressure deficits.

- Creates exclusion zones
- Generates pressure gradients
- Determines effective interaction areas

## 3. MOVEMENT (Shunt Dynamics)

Movement emerges from shunt events: RESISTANCE → RECOIL → TRANSFERENCE.

- Shunt events drive all motion
- Creates circulation $\Gamma$
- Establishes frequency $\nu$

## 4. NOW (Time Emergence)

Time is not fundamental but emerges from counting shunt events.

$$t = \frac{N_{\text{shunts}}}{\nu}$$

- No fundamental time dimension
- Causality from contact propagation
- Time emerges from counting

## Significance

All physical phenomena can be described as combinations of these four primitives. No additional assumptions are needed.
